messages:
maria: Quick poll — YAML karaoke tonight or SemVer stand-up? :microphone: :yum:
devin: YAML karaoke. I can do an emotional indentation ballad. :notes: :laughing:
sam: SemVer stand-up. I'll hit you with a 2.0.0 joke and a 2.0.1 apology. :rolling_on_the_floor_laughing:
maria: @sam that patch apology better be backwards compatible :sweat_smile:
lee: Honestly I'll bring my accordion and do a compiler impression: 'Segmentation fault... but make it jazz.' :accordion:
jamie: I can do YAML spoken-word: "- list
  - of
    - feelings" dramatic pause, mic drop. :drop_of_blood: :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
devin: Could we also have a bonus round: name a bug using only semver numbers? I call 0.0.0 (mystery crash). :face_with_monocle:
ops-bot: Reminder: office kitchen closes at 7pm tonight — karaoke starts at 7:30pm.
maria: Perfect timing. BYO sarcasm and a backup parser. :thumbsup:
sam: Also bringing stickers: "I survived dependency hell (and all I got was this semver)."
lee: If someone shows up with a YAML file as a costume I will take a picture. :camera_with_flash:
jamie: Prize for best compiler impression is a bag of old GPUs (kidding? maybe). :smile:
devin: Not kidding. I have one dusty Titan in the corner. :eyes:
maria: Okay, poll result so far: YAML songs 2, SemVer jokes 1, compiler impressions 3. Anyone else?
lee: +1 for compiler impressions. :metal:
sam: +1 for SemVer puns (but I support the musicians).
jamie: Also can we please avoid anyone doing the 'merge conflict' interpretive dance. Trauma. :grimacing:
maria: Noted. Rule: no merge-conflict choreography unless it's a duet. :grimacing: :ok_hand:
ops-bot: Event: "Office Tech Variety Hour" created. Calendar invite sent to #random.
maria: Awesome, see y'all there. Bring snacks and bad jokes. :chipmunk:
